I’m a multidisciplinary designer with a background in design education at the National Institute of Design. My interests span visual communication, textiles, materials and digital experiences. I approach design through observation, research and experimentation, translating ideas into considered visual outcomes that balance aesthetics, function and meaning.

Working across disciplines has taught me to look beyond the surface of a design. I’m interested in the relationship between material and form, image and meaning, and aesthetics and functionality. I’m continually learning through new tools, perspectives and collaborations.
